messages:
Sophia: FYI partner wants to convert 6 racks from our reserved Q4 allocation into marketplace credits they can re-sell. They claim a factory firmware hold means +5 week delay on physical delivery. Asking if wecan accept credits instead of hardware and what that means for SI installs and our joint marketplace listing.
Arjun: 6 racks = ~48 GPUs in APAC-EU pools? Need exact region mapping. If we take credits, SI rollouts that require on-prem hardware (air-gapped) break. Which reservations specifically?
CloudRep: CloudRep: Apologies factory retest on one SKU. Affected reservations: APAC-R-77211, EU-R-77212, SI-IMPL-5501, SI-IMPL-5502, MARKET-POOL-33, MARKET-POOL-34. We can offer equivalent marketplace credits or expedite 2 racks per region for an extra fee.
Maya: Two SI implementations are contract-bound with install windows and signed SOWs. Those cannot be credits unless we re-negotiate downtimes with the customers & SI partner. That takes legal and sales sign-off.
Ben: MarketingOps: If we accept credits and the partner lists them on the marketplace, they want our "supported on Redwood" badge on the marketplace tile. Partner rule: no co-marketing badge until device-based QA finishes. Can we list credits now and gate the hardware mention?
AJ-bot: inventory-scan: shows MARKET-POOL-33/34 flagged as marketplace-eligible; SI-IMPL items marked hardware-only.
Sophia: Proposed split: 1) Convert MARKET-POOL-33/34 and APAC-R-77211 to credits (market announcement OK); 2) Hold EU-R-77212 and SI-IMPL-5501/5502 for hardware and request expedited ship for EU rack (1) to cover SI test; 3) Legal to issue amendment for SI contracts if credits accepted.
CloudRep: Confirmed partial split possible. Expedited shipment will require ATA paperwork and expedite fee. Logo/badge use: partner restricts co-branding for hardware until post-QC. Credits listing can call out Redwood integration now.
Arjun: Engineering impact: credits -> route customers to hosted or ephemeral dedicated pools. Need to update routing policies, eviction windows, and model-affinity to avoid cold KV cache misses. Estimate 2 days ops work per mapping plus 4h for a canary rollout.
Maya: I'll coordinate with SI and Sales. If we ask SI to accept hosted fallback, we must ensure data residency compliance for those customers (onboarding terms). That could require privacy sign-off.
Ben: MarketingOps: We'll do a two-phase announcement: Phase A (marketplace credits live, partner logo OK per partner note), Phase B (hardware availability + co-marketing badge once QA passes). Draft embargo schedule and share.
Sophia: Risk note: customers with QoS SLAs tied to physical racks may request refunds or credits. Finance: need contingency for pro-rated credits.
AJ-bot: contract-check: SI-IMPL-5501 contains a hard clause on "hardware-delivery-by" Sept 15. Flag legal review.
Inventory-bot: manifest-update: partner marked APAC-R-77211 as convertible, EU-R-77212 held.
CloudRep: We'll provide airwaybills and expedite ETA by EOD tomorrow if you confirm split. We cannot allow partner logo on hardware until QC.
Sophia: Decision: approve partial conversion. Action items: 1) Maya/Sales start contract amendment w/ Legal; 2) Arjun/EngOps begin routing change plan and canary; 3) MarketingOps prepare phased announcement + embargo; 4) Finance model pro-rated credit exposure; 5) Sophia to confirm split to CloudRep by EOD. Standup sync 09:45 tomorrow. :white_check_mark:
